content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: BE; MSc; M.Tech; Ph.D. Other conditions: Those in employment must submit 'No Objection Certificate' from the employer. Candidates are required to provide their Skype ID, email address and mobile number. Desirable: Experience of Managing Cleanroom Facility in a central facility in national/international research institute. Previous experience in handling Maskless lithography, coating units, inside cleanroom facility and related instrumentation or electronics will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The final remuneration shall be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and documented proof of excellence. Initial engagement would be for a period of six months and extendable on requirement and performance review of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form Scan copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc Brief resume

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Get the application form: template available on website. Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Email it to [email protected] . Email it on or before 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in person.
